description: Log4Shell flagship case: HTTP endpoint logs attacker input through log4j2 2.14.1. A benign endpoint logs a constant. A scheduled job logs a configured template.

expected.why: GET /api/greet logs the 'name' request parameter; log4j2 resolves ${...} lookups in the message and reaches JndiLookup.lookup.
snakeyaml is on the shared sample classpath but no A code parses YAML.
commons-collections is on the shared sample classpath but no A code uses its functors.
xstream is on the classpath; no A code calls XStream.

mustNotClaim.why: This is Log4Shell actually reachable from an HTTP endpoint; calling it unreachable is the worst possible failure.
